events.event_name: Mary Kay ‘Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared’ Pop-Up
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: An oversized public beauty experience celebrating Mary Kay’s Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with beauty touch-ups, product experiences and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Free public admission, full-size Mary Kay product giveaways, beauty touch-ups and interactive experiences.
events.caveats: Current NYC event listings independently agree on September 15, 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza and explicitly describe the activation as free/open to the public. Mary Kay’s official campaign announcement confirms that its real-world consumer-event rollout begins in New York this month, but does not itself publish the Gansevoort event logistics.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public activation at Gansevoort Plaza. Full-size product giveaways are promoted; quantities are not guaranteed, so earlier arrival is safer for freebies.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A branded eos × NYLON truck celebrating eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments on the final day of NYFW.
events.what_is_free: Free public access with Dewy Lip Shine sampling and branded sweet treats while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current event listing states the truck is open to the public from 12–5 PM and that sampling/treats are while supplies last. No RSVP or ticket requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: Street-level SoHo truck activation. Product samples and treats are while supplies last; arrive earlier if the giveaway is the priority.

events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt St, New York, NY 10007

subway.station: Cortlandt St / WTC Cortlandt / Fulton St

events.what_it_is: A two-day public in-store Fashion Week runway where anyone can walk the Century 21 runway; participants can opt into being filmed for the store’s social stories.
events.what_is_free: Free runway participation. Each walker receives a Century 21 tote, up to five iron-on patches and a $21-off-$100 in-store card, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Century 21’s official page confirms September 15 and 16, 12–6 PM both days, with no ticket, invitation or online registration. Giveaways are while supplies last. Filming is described by Century 21 as part of the walk; a current secondary listing says participants opt in at the runway station.
events.practical_notes: Enter on the Dey Street side of the main floor and get in line. No RSVP is required. Earlier arrival gives the best chance at tote/patch availability.
